description: WHO estimates of tuberculosis burden by country and year — TB incidence per 100 000 and in absolute cases with uncertainty ranges, TB mortality, the share of TB cases that are HIV-positive, and case detection rate. Covers 217 countries from 2000 onward. Use for questions about how much tuberculosis a country has, TB death rates, and TB trends over time.

country.description: Country name or ISO code, e.g. "India", "IND", "KE". Omit for all countries.

years.description: Year or range, e.g. "2023" or "2015-2023". Omit for all years.

name: who_tb_estimates
title: Who Tb Estimates
